items.item_title: What’s in a Salmon Belly Fin pack?
Is it suitable for dogs and cats?
How long will a pack last?
How is the food delivered and stored?

settings.editor: Premium salmon belly fins, prepared raw and snap-frozen — no fillers, grains or artificial additives. The pack size and contents are printed on every label.
Yes. Salmon belly fins suit both dogs and cats as a meal, a topper or a tasty reward. See our feeding guide for how much to serve.
It depends on your pet’s size and how you serve it. Use the portion calculator to work out a daily amount, then check it against the pack size on the label.
Delivered frozen to preserve raw nutrition. Simply thaw in the fridge before serving. Pop it straight in the freezer when it arrives and thaw only what you need. Delivery & storage info →
No. Once thawed, keep it covered in the fridge and use it within the time shown on the pack. Refreezing thawed raw food affects both texture and food safety, so thaw one portion at a time.
